runs.summary: Significant (no new model, but two default behaviors changed plus a broad tooling/config/security batch). Releases v2.1.271-v2.1.278 since prior v2.1.270 (v2.1.272 & v2.1.276 are bugfix/regression-only). Headline 1: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md directly - a repo with no CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md on the working-dir path loads every AGENTS.md/.claude/AGENTS.md as project instructions; default Project instructions setting is claude-md-or-agents-md (options claude-md-and-agents-md/claude-md/managed-only), set in /config; requires v2.1.277+, unavailable on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/telemetry-disabled (v2.1.277, corroborated by the memory doc). Headline 2: auto mode's safety classifier now runs server-side by default for Claude API & Enterprise and on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateways, un-billed for classifier overhead; falls back to the billed local classifier with a one-time notice when the server can't reach the session (gateway strips the safeguards field / safeguard_results); new /status 'Auto mode server' row; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 opts out (not read on direct API), documented temporary (v2.1.278, corroborated by the auto-mode-classifier-billing doc) - this reverses the v2.1.273 flip of Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry to the local classifier. Other: TaskOutput tool removed (taskOutputMaxChars/TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH now inert), subagent results framed as subagent output + invisible-Unicode prompt scrubbing, Fable always shown in /model on the Anthropic API, background Haiku auto-title dropped from claude -p outside SDK/IDE, CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY (v2.1.277). omitClaudeMd for subagents, per-command allowed_domains in sandboxed auto mode, inline ! in skills/slash commands follow default-mode rules, Monitor watches always deadlined (max 30m; 10 in -p) replacing persistent, --accept-command <sha256> for plugin install/update, modelPricing multiplier up to 10, fullscreen /config mouse support, Markdown artifacts render styled + watch up to 10, dynamic-workflow default small on Pro (v2.1.271). x-claude-code-* gateway hint headers + Remote Control forking (v2.1.273). CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS, OTel effort span attr + claude_code.managed_settings_resolved event, cloud-provider v2 MCP client default (opt out MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1/MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy), /code-review lean inline prompts for untuned models, type:sdk MCP entries skipped, tighter Bash permission checks (v2.1.274). Send-now key Ctrl+Enter, claude.ai skill/plugin sync to terminal (syncClaudeAiSkills/syncClaudeAiPlugins), /plugin install --marketplace, npm plugins fetched with npm pack --ignore-scripts, git/ssh/marketplace URL secret redaction (v2.1.275). CLI advanced v2.1.270 -> v2.1.278. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on the GitHub Releases API (authoritative, all 8 new release bodies) + the Claude Code memory doc (AGENTS.md) and auto-mode-classifier-billing doc (both headline claims corroborated). Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): every version-attributed claim verified against v2.1.271-v2.1.278 release bodies; the only correction was narrowing 'the Claude apps gateway' back to 'gateways' in the v2.1.278 What's New bullet to match the release body and the artifact's own Summary.

Significant (a config-surface batch plus security and prompt-cache hardening; no new model). Releases v2.1.265-v2.1.270 since prior v2.1.263 (v2.1.264 never tagged; v2.1.266 & v2.1.270 are pure regression fixes). Headlines: maxEffortLevel setting caps effort on every provider incl Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, top-level or per-model under modelSettings, lowest cap wins (v2.1.267, corroborated by the settings docs which state it requires v2.1.267+); --system-prompt-snapshot off renders the system prompt fresh each request; effort: frontmatter now honored on pinned-effort models Opus 4.7/4.8/Fable 5 (v2.1.267); claude plugin eval runs scored reproducible plugin eval suites (JSON+HTML report), /output-style [name] lists/switches styles incl headless/cloud, bashEditDiffEnabled adds a diff of files a Bash command changed, plus env vars CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS/OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY/CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS/CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING (v2.1.269); --json across the plugin CLI + configDirectory in auth status --json, gateway.yaml pricing: propagation + gatewayInternalNetworks + empty-allow_cidrs warning, self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state, CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS (WebFetch 300s deadline), the task-tracking-tools model list made explicit (Claude 3.x/Opus 4.0-4.7/Sonnet 4.0-4.6/Haiku 4.5, refining v2.1.233), WebFetch rules no longer covering Artifact reads, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry system-prompt-as-attachments + byte-stable tool list (v2.1.268); a security-hardening pass (symlinked-dir deny rules, deny rules through env -C/eval and tee, ${VAR} secret redaction in /mcp & plugin errors, !-negation rules scoped to their source, PermissionRequest hooks in --print, plugin archive permissions; v2.1.268/269); --plugin-dir folder support, 1GB tool-result disk cap, non-interactive cd persistence, MCP http->SSE fallback (v2.1.265); and a large prompt-cache-stability pass across resume/model-switch/MCP-reconnect (v2.1.265/267/269). CLI advanced v2.1.263 -> v2.1.270. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on the GitHub Releases API (authoritative, all 6 new release bodies) + the Claude Code settings docs (maxEffortLevel corroborated, requires v2.1.267+). Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): every version-attributed claim verified against v2.1.265-v2.1.270 release bodies; the only defect was two orphan references (v2.1.266, v2.1.270), fixed by adding inline [2]/[6] markers in the History Log.

Significant (a new model + a wave of settings/flags/security defaults). Releases v2.1.252-v2.1.263 since prior v2.1.251 (v2.1.253-254/256/262 have no GitHub Release tags; v2.1.255 shipped briefly and introduced the macOS 12 launch regression fixed in v2.1.258). Headline: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) is the new default Fable model - 1M context, $10/$50 per Mtok, cache reads 2.5% of input (~$0.25/Mtok), adaptive thinking always on, high default effort, Jun 2026 cutoff (v2.1.257, corroborated by the Anthropic models overview docs); gateways keep resolving fable/best to Fable 5 until configured, so pick 5.1 in /model. Other new: timeFormat/timeZone settings; auto-mode 'Containment Escape' rule (no longer auto-approving cloud metadata-credential fetches/egress evasion/cross-tenant reach); CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE; permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories; 's' in /effort; project-settings defaultMode bypassPermissions now ignored; --add-dir refuses network paths (v2.1.257). managedMcpServers managed setting + allowedMcpServers scope change; --permission-prompts none for headless; claude plugin validate --json; unparseable managed settings refuse startup (v2.1.259). /diff fullscreen panel; /cost cache-miss cause; text /advisor + /reload-plugins in headless; 1M-model auto-compact tuning; managed claudeMd no longer triggers approval; ! bash-mode outside sandbox in strict; removed 1h subagent-bg-command limit; reverted the v2.1.259 Read()-deny-on-Bash-args change (v2.1.260). bashOutputMaxChars/taskOutputMaxChars (up to 128K); --append-subagent-system-prompt-file; /skill-doctor; keybindingFlavor removed (word keys always Bash); dangerous-rm detection extended; diagram-renderer-URL upload no longer auto-approved (v2.1.261). v2.1.252/258/263 are bug-fix/reliability releases. CLI advanced v2.1.251 -> v2.1.263. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on the GitHub Releases API (authoritative, all 7 new release bodies) + the Anthropic models overview docs (Fable 5.1 specs/pricing corroborated). Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): fixed the 'v2.1.255 never published' overstatement (v2.1.258 confirms it shipped) and added the v2.1.260 citation for ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL; two other reviewer claims were rejected as misreads of the release bodies (keybindingFlavor is v2.1.261-only; ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL is a real setting, documented in v2.1.260).

Significant (a model-default change + a substantial security batch; no new model shipped). Releases v2.1.245-v2.1.251 since prior v2.1.241 (v2.1.242-244/249 never released). Headlines: seat-based Enterprise subscriptions now default to Opus 5, matching other premium plans (v2.1.251); new PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch hook events that can block/confirm/annotate a model switch + SessionStart resume hooks receive session staleness and re-cache cost (v2.1.251, corroborated by hooks docs); new --restricted / CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1 locked-down mode that drops command/code tools + WebFetch, confines file tools to the working dir, refuses bypassPermissions, and ignores settings files (v2.1.248); per-agent experimental.cacheTtl frontmatter (v2.1.248); CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL softened to a default that per-agent/per-spawn models override (v2.1.251); SendFeedback tool + feedbackDrafts setting (v2.1.247); Auto-mode tab in /permissions (v2.1.246) + one-keystroke switch-to-auto-mode on Bash prompts (v2.1.247); prompt-cache line in /cost + Spend-limit bar in /usage with status-line fields (v2.1.251); claude attach <id> + attach/logs/stop/respawn/rm in --help (v2.1.251); /effort saved per model (v2.1.251); Sonnet 5 auto-compacts on the full 1M window ~967K (v2.1.247); /claude-api cost-optimize + Admin API coverage (v2.1.247); a broad file-access/sandbox hardening pass (Read/Write/Edit symlink-swap TOCTOU, Grep/Glob deny rules through symlinks, plugin-command path traversal, project settings can't enable beta tracing/raw logging, project env can't set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/TMPDIR, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS + sandbox-weakening managed settings require approval; all v2.1.251); /usage-credits for Enterprise + same-machine cross-session messaging on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry + /loop dynamic/autonomous always available (v2.1.248); Workflow tool description ~5.7k->~1k tokens (v2.1.248); syntax highlighting removed for six langs + binary ~5MB smaller (v2.1.251). v2.1.245 (glibc 2.44 startup crash fix) and v2.1.250 are bugfix-only. CLI advanced v2.1.241 -> v2.1.251. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on the GitHub Releases API (authoritative, all 6 release bodies) + Claude Code hooks docs (PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch corroborated). Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass): every version-attributed claim verified against v2.1.245-v2.1.251 release bodies (v2.1.249 confirmed non-existent), no fabrications, all 7 citations resolve, version math correct; no corrections needed.

Significant (new settings/env vars/defaults; no new models). Releases v2.1.234-v2.1.241 since prior v2.1.233. Headlines: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var sets the starting model softly, yielding to a /model pick and to a file model key, unlike ANTHROPIC_MODEL (v2.1.236); built-in 'Concise' output style (v2.1.237); auto-continue session when a claude.ai usage limit resets, toggle in /config (v2.1.234); spellcheck setting via aspell/hunspell/ispell (v2.1.235); keybindingFlavor:'readline' for Bash-style word keys (v2.1.238/239); plugin-marketplace headersHelper mints short-lived HTTP auth headers with trust + credential isolation (v2.1.238); Windows cross-session messaging + notify_when_idle on SendMessage (v2.1.236/239); self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min and --proxy-authorization-command/file (v2.1.238); auto-mode classifier parity on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry + Monitor reviewed like Bash (v2.1.236); CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME + GitLab MR badge + 'Default teammate model' removed + mid-turn /permissions & /add-dir (v2.1.234); cost estimates include the 1.1x US-only-inference premium + /claude-api upgrade for anthropic 0.x->1.x + cloud plugins name@synced (v2.1.239). v2.1.240/241 bugfix-only. CLI advanced v2.1.233 -> v2.1.241. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on the GitHub Releases API (authoritative, all 8 release bodies) + Claude Code settings docs (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL precedence corroborated). Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass): every claim verified against v2.1.234-v2.1.241 release notes and settings docs, no fabrications, citations clean, version math correct; no corrections needed.

Significant (default-behavior/config changes; no new models). Releases v2.1.227-v2.1.233 since prior v2.1.226. Headlines: subagent forking on by default (subagent_type:'fork' inherits full conversation + prompt cache; non-teammate spawns background-by-default, v2.1.232); task/todo tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) removed on Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5 and newer models, gated behind CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 (v2.1.233); @-mention another session + bare-name SendMessage + unique per-machine names (v2.1.232); broad GitLab support (marketplaces incl. nested subgroups + token redaction v2.1.232, MR URLs in --worktree/claude agents v2.1.233); Write tool matches Edit overwrite rules for newer models (v2.1.228); /code-review high/xhigh/max background + plugin marketplace command sources + tighter /commit-push-pr defaults (v2.1.229/232); new env vars CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT/WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS/WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS. CLI advanced v2.1.226 -> v2.1.233. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on GitHub Releases API (authoritative) + settings docs corroboration. Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): added the omitted v2.1.231 MCP OAuth fix (Slack-style pre-registered clients) to complete range coverage; all other claims verified.

Significant (feature/config changes; no new models). Three releases since v2.1.223: v2.1.224 added self-hosted runners (claude self-hosted-runner, Team/Enterprise), cross-session SendMessage across machines, the archive plugin source with SHA-256 pinning, crossSessionInbound/dialogExpiry settings, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX, sandbox credential-masking, and removed the 200-subagent-per-session cap; v2.1.225 added a claude agents workspace-trust prompt, gateway spend-limit surfacing, and Remote Control SendMessage-by-name; v2.1.226 is bug-fixes only. CLI advanced v2.1.223 -> v2.1.226. WebSearch/HN/Reddit unavailable in CI; relied on GitHub Releases API + settings/plugins docs. Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): REVIEW_NOTES_PLACEHOLDER removed and the crossSessionInbound default description corrected to its session-class-dependent behavior.

Highly significant period. Two new default models (Sonnet 5 v2.1.197, Opus 5 v2.1.219), base permission mode renamed 'Manual' (v2.1.200), subagents background-by-default + Claude in Chrome GA + /dataviz (v2.1.198), auto mode without opt-in on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (v2.1.207), org default models, screen reader mode, /config key=value, Tool(param:value) rules. CLI advanced v2.1.162 -> v2.1.223. Cross-model reviewed by Sonnet 5 (pass_with_edits): Opus 5 positioning and subagent-cap release attribution corrected.
v1.0 baseline generated and cross-model reviewed.
